**Norfolk Southern Corp. (CIK 702165) — Railway Operating Ratio, FY2024 vs. FY2023**

**Answer:** Operating efficiency improved markedly in the most recent period. Norfolk Southern's railway operating ratio (railway operating expenses ÷ railway operating revenues — the share of revenue consumed by expenses, so lower is better) fell to **66.4% in full-year 2024**, from **76.5% in 2023** — an improvement of about **10.1 percentage points**. On an adjusted (non-GAAP) basis, excluding the Eastern Ohio Incident and other items, the ratio improved to **65.8%** from **67.4%** (about 1.6 points better).

**Supporting figures (FY ended Dec 31, $ millions):**
| Item | 2024 | 2023 | 2022 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Railway operating revenues | 12,123 | 12,156 | 12,745 |
| Railway operating expenses | 8,052 | 9,305 | 7,936 |
| Income from railway operations | 4,071 | 2,851 | 4,809 |
| Railway operating ratio (disclosed) | 66.4% | 76.5% | 62.3% |

**Verification:** Recomputing from the database facts gives 8,052/12,123 = 66.4% (2024), 9,305/12,156 = 76.5% (2023), and 7,936/12,745 = 62.3% (2022), matching the disclosed ratios.

**Why it moved:** The 2024 improvement was driven mainly by lower railway operating expenses (−13%), including lower net costs related to the Eastern Ohio Incident and $433 million of gains on sales of railway lines, while revenues were roughly flat (volumes up ~5% but offset by lower fuel surcharge revenue and adverse mix). The 2023 deterioration (76.5% vs. 62.3% in 2022) was largely due to ~$1.1 billion of Incident-related expenses plus inflation and service costs. Management also noted the 2024 result included an adjusted operating ratio of 65.8%, both improving year over year.

**Sources:**
- FY2024 10-K (report_end 2024-12-31, accession 0000702165-25-000008): chunk 702165/nsc-20241231:38400 (five-year operating ratio table), chunk 702165/nsc-20241231:115200 (summarized results and MD&A), chunk 702165/nsc-20241231:121600 (adjusted/non-GAAP ratio).
- FY2023 10-K (report_end 2023-12-31, accession 0000702165-24-000005): chunk 702165/nsc-20231231:104000 and 702165/nsc-20231231:108800.
- Financial facts: revenue IDs 859736 (2024), 859727 (2023), 859715 (2022); CostsAndExpenses IDs 847174 (2024), 847165 (2023), 847153 (2022); OperatingIncomeLoss IDs 855259, 855250, 855238.

**Limitations:** The operating ratio is a company-defined railway metric (not a GAAP line item); the 66.4% and 65.8% figures are as disclosed, and the 65.8% is a non-GAAP adjusted measure. The 2024 ratio benefited from one-time items (Incident cost reduction and line-sale gains), so the adjusted comparison (65.8% vs. 67.4%) is the cleaner read on underlying efficiency.
